meta.name: Father Knows Best
meta.description: Family man Jim Anderson copes with the everyday problems among his wife Margaret and their three children as they experience day-to-day changes.

videos.title: Bud Takes Up the Dance
videos.overview: Bud tries to learn how to dance from a book for his first school dance.

videos.title: Lesson in Citizenship
videos.overview: Jim tells his family to help others which leads to complications.

videos.title: The Motor Scooter
videos.overview: Jim buys Bud a motor scooter but Margaret won't let him have it.

videos.title: Football Tickets
videos.overview: Jim gets tickets to an important football game, and picks one of the kids to go with him—only to be blackmailed by an important client (who wants to go to the game, too) out of one of his tickets. He then tries frantically to find a second one.

videos.title: Live My Own Life
videos.overview: Bud moves out, but discovers he can't clean, cook, or take    care of himself.

videos.title: Grandpa Jim's Rejuvenation
videos.overview: Jim comes to believe that he is over the hill.

videos.title: Bud's Encounter With the Law
videos.overview: Bud becomes increasingly paranoid when Kathy (who has a fascination with the new washing machine, and puts everything in there) places a letter addressed to him by the police department in the washing machine, and ruins the letter, so he doesn’t know why he is asked to be there within seven days.

videos.title: Thanksgiving Day
videos.overview: Kathy writes the best poem in the fourth grade on what Thanksgiving means to her, and Jim builds the poem up in his mind to unreasonable expectations for a fourth grader. When he actually finds out what the poem consists of, his hopes for Kathy’s future are deflated and he disparages the poem to Margaret, unwitting that Kathy has overheard.

videos.title: Second Honeymoon
videos.overview: Jim's weekend retreat, just he and his wife, seems like a perfect idea, at first. But he doesn't want to pass this on to the kids when he learns that the kids have plans with them; and then when the kids take the news too easy, Jim and Margaret are befuddled. They leave, but soon they start thinking about their kids and after reaching the lodge they want to phone in - but no one answers the call...

videos.title: Typical Father
videos.overview: Jim becomes worried that things between Betty and a new male friend of hers are getting too serious.

videos.title: Margaret Goes Dancing
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret rarely disagree on anything. But when he finds out Margaret signed them up to take dancing lessons, Jim refuses to do so, and ends up defiantly going to his old club, leaving her to take lessons alone.

videos.title: The Christmas Story
videos.overview: Jim takes the family into the woods to cut down their own tree, and they become stranded there.

videos.title: Sparrow in the Window
videos.overview: Kathy discovers a wounded Sparrow on the windowsill of the house—which she then considers hers—and the whole family becomes involved in trying to help it get better.

videos.title: Boy's Week
videos.overview: Jim receives a traffic ticket and Bud is appointed to be    judge on that day.

videos.title: A Friend of Old George's
videos.overview: An unwanted visitor that won't leave spoils Kathy's birthday    party.

videos.title: Bud the Snob
videos.overview: Bud is deemed a snob by the girls in school because he won’t speak to any of them. When Jim talks it over with him, he discovers that Bud‘s real problem is that he becomes tongue-tied around them.

videos.title: The Promised Playhouse
videos.overview: After making a big deal about people keeping their word, Jim is forced to put his words into practice to set a good example for his family.

videos.title: Jim the Farmer
videos.overview: Jim wants to give up his office job in order to move into the country to lead a quiet, and less stressful, life as a farmer. Margaret doesn't think that he means it seriously, but he crosses more lines to fulfill his dream than he ever has before.

videos.title: Father of the Year
videos.overview: Jim is happy to learn his kids are planning to enter him in a Father of the Year contest. But things, of course, don’t go smoothly.

videos.title: The Mink Coat
videos.overview: Even though finances have grown a little tight in the Anderson household, Jim buys Margaret a mink coat that ends up being more trouble than it’s worth.

videos.title: The Matchmaker
videos.overview: Margaret tries to get her cousin and her boyfriend married.

videos.title: Bud the Bridesmaid
videos.overview: Margaret's cousin (from the previous episode) is set to wed in the Anderson household, but things go wrong, due to the nervousness of the prospective bride and groom, and the wedding is called off. Poor Bud is reeled in to do a stand-in for the bride at the rehearsal.

videos.title: Proud Father
videos.overview: Jim tries to help the children regain their confidence.

videos.title: Father Delivers the Papers
videos.overview: Bud injures himself, so Jim delivers the papers on his route to avoid Bud being fired.

videos.title: No Partiality
videos.overview: Kathy and Betty fight for the attention of the same man.

videos.title: Close Decision
videos.overview: Margaret worries the entire day over what will become of Bud’s future if he doesn’t develop good character. This is tied in with a baseball game Bud is trying to get to play in.

videos.title: Art of Salesmanship
videos.overview: Jim tries to encourage Bud to take after him in salesmanship.

videos.title: Father's Private Life
videos.overview: Jim comes home tired one day and is harangued by the kids. So, he and Margaret set up new rules to give him some time to relax—but it ends up backfiring.

videos.title: Lessons in Civics
videos.overview: A new highway is getting built, and for that the old community hall is going to be pulled down. That's something Jim wouldn't like to see since the hall is a historical monument, and also, memories from his youth are connected with this hall. Everyone from the family sees how much the hall means to Jim, and they use different ways to organize help.

videos.title: First Disillusionment
videos.overview: Bud loses a job to a boy who fakes his resumé, which leads him  to believe it is alright to do this himself

videos.title: Woman in the House
videos.overview: Margaret is forced to invite a woman over who makes her uncomfortable  because she is Jim's friend's wife.

videos.title: New Girl at School
videos.overview: Bud learns that the girl he likes is dating his best friend.

videos.title: Kathy Makes Magic
videos.overview: Kathy gets a new magic set, from a trade with a friend, and becomes convinced she can truly wield magic.

videos.title: Advantage to Betty
videos.overview: Betty has recently taken up tennis at school and is chosen for a photo shoot for the paper. This causes friction between her and her doubles partner, Eula, who is the team’s best player.

videos.title: The Big Test
videos.overview: Bud is accused of cheating because he is suddenly getting high   grades in class.

videos.title: Father Is a Dope
videos.overview: After commenting on a sitcom (“Father Does It Again”) the family watches together one night, Jim speaks about how TV fathers are often portrayed as dumb in comparison with their families.  Later, he plans on going hunting and starts believing that Margaret and the kids are secretly trying to get him to stay.

videos.title: Spirit of Youth
videos.overview: When Jim gets an invitation to a dance for his class reunion—class of ‘33—the kids start behaving as if their parents are ancient. Then, when the kids at their alma mater treat them the same, Jim and Margaret deal with the thought of getting older.

videos.title: Bud, the Ladykiller
videos.overview: Bud gets irritated by a girl (whom he refers to as “Dumb Dora”) who has a crush on him, hurts her feelings when his irritation leads to cruelty, and must make amends.

videos.title: Margaret's Premonition
videos.overview: Margaret has a premonition of danger for Jim’s upcoming business trip, and tries to get Jim to postpone it. But Jim believes it’s a bunch of superstitious nonsense, and insists on going anyway.

videos.title: Stage to Yuma
videos.overview: Tate Idsen saves a stagecoach from savage Indians in a    flashback sequence.

videos.title: Bad Influence
videos.overview: Bud gets in trouble when his latest friend turns out to be a kleptomaniac.

videos.title: Betty Hates Carter
videos.overview: Betty is indignant when Jim arranges a date for her with an old insurance salesman buddy’s son, Carter.

videos.title: Jim, the Tyrant
videos.overview: Jim comes home early from work, after a long, hard day, and expects to gain comfort from his family, but is quickly disillusioned when they all are too absorbed in their own interests and tasks to pay attention to him. This just makes his mood more sour and he declares at dinner that if he must, he will become a tyrant. This leads to unwelcome consequences.

videos.title: Betty's Brother
videos.overview: Bud is having trouble in school and the family are hard-pressed to find out why. Eventually, Jim and Margaret come to the conclusion that, since he’s entered high school, he’s lost his confidence over being constantly compared to Betty and her accomplishments.

videos.title: Betty Earns a Formal
videos.overview: Betty gets a job to pay for a new, expensive formal for the Cinderella Ball at the country club.

videos.title: The House Painter
videos.overview: Jim has a bet with Betty and Margaret concerning human nature, integrity and the man painting their house—Mr. Everett.

videos.title: Bud, the Wallflower
videos.overview: Bud seems determined not to go to a Senior/Freshman dance that is Sadie Hawkins-themed.

videos.title: The Bus to Nowhere
videos.overview: Betty becomes irritable with her family as she goes through an existential crisis.

videos.title: Kathy, the Indian Giver
videos.overview: Kathy is taught about fair trading from her father—and ends up trading her doll for a real baby.

videos.title: The Historical Andersons
videos.overview: When Bud receives an assignment to write a term paper about a Revolutionary War hero, he ends up researching the life of a relative—Major Nathaniel Oliver Anderson.

videos.title: The Grass is Greener
videos.overview: Jim’s old college friend, Charlie Bradley, a successful industrial tycoon, is in town. Charlie, along with Jim, were a part of a group known as The Four Musketeers, in college. Of the four, Jim appears to be the least ‘successful.’

videos.title: The Persistent Guest
videos.overview: Bud’s new friend, Fred, won't leave the Anderson house.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: The family tries to think up excuses to keep from going to    Margaret's family reunion.

videos.title: Family Dines Out
videos.overview: Betty tells a wealthy friend, Eloise Sanders, that she’s going to a charity dinner at a club. But it’s expensive and she hasn’t asked her father, yet.

videos.title: Bud, the Boxer
videos.overview: Bud gets in a tussle with a boy, Eddie,  at school, then dreads facing him the next day because the kid wants to fight him. Jim makes Bud face him in a boxing ring to settle it, knowing that Bud will have to face Eddie, eventually. Later, Jim has Bud take boxing lessons.

videos.title: Betty, Girl Engineer
videos.overview: Betty takes a vocational guidance course and signs up to get practical experience to become an engineer, but she gets a lot of flack for it because she’s a girl.

videos.title: The Martins and the Coys
videos.overview: Jim and a family friend, Frank, fight over an insurance claim and dissolve their friendship over it. Betty and his son, Bob, are dating and this affects them, too.

videos.title: Dilemma for Margaret
videos.overview: Margaret is asked to represent her branch of the PTA by giving a speech, but later decides against doing so because of some mischief Betty gets into.

videos.title: Hero Father
videos.overview: Bud boasts to his friends, Sandy and Kippy, that his dad can get Duke Snider’s All-Stars to come to Springfield.

videos.title: Father, the Naturalist
videos.overview: Jim fights the elements to collect plants for Kathy's nature folder.

videos.title: The Ten Dollar Question
videos.overview: Jim makes a bet: the kid who doesn't tattle for one week will receive ten dollars.

videos.title: Adopted Daughter
videos.overview: Kathy finds a receipt for $25 from the adoption center and    believes she was adopted.

videos.title: Betty's Graduation
videos.overview: While the family is readying for Betty’s graduation, Betty becomes conflicted about the event.

videos.title: No Apron Strings
videos.overview: Bud tries to prove he's not tied to his mother's apron strings.

videos.title: Never in Twain
videos.overview: On a dude ranch, Betty falls in love with a cowboy only to discover the relationship won't last.

videos.title: Betty Goes to College
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret are excited about Betty going to the state college they attended. Betty, who wants to, at first, changes her mind.

videos.title: Man About Town
videos.overview: Kippy promises Bud a date with his beautiful cousin, Marissa.

videos.title: The Homing Pigeon
videos.overview: Jim tries discouraging Betty from moving into an apartment. Bud and the family await the arrival of Charlie, a homing pigeon.

videos.title: Spaghetti for Margaret
videos.overview: The Andersons entertain an aspiring writer—aspiring for 30 years.

videos.title: Betty's Birthday
videos.overview: After listening to a lecture in class on the origins of giving gifts, Betty announces that she doesn't want a birthday party or presents.

videos.title: Bud, the Millionaire
videos.overview: To teach Bud a lesson, Jim gives him ten dollars a week for allowance, but he's not to spend the money on anyone else but himself, even indirectly.

videos.title: The Old Days
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret complain about the children's sloppy clothes. The kids judge the antiquated attire they choose for a PTA costume party.

videos.title: Whistle Bait
videos.overview: Betty becomes insecure after she overhears Bud tell Jim that she’s not the kind of girl boys whistle at.

videos.title: The Great Guy
videos.overview: Bud and Kippy get a job working at a newspaper.

videos.title: The Family Goes to New York
videos.overview: Jim is reluctant to let Betty go to New York to be a bridesmaid to her friend Barbara—afraid she’ll get hurt, somehow.

videos.title: Betty Goes Steady
videos.overview: Betty is going steady according to the rules of her school’s social set. But a guy with a chip on his shoulder challenges her preconceptions.

videos.title: The Good Prospect
videos.overview: The Andersons try bringing an old man out of his dream world.

videos.title: The Angel's Sweater
videos.overview: Jim’s sister comes for Christmas, and the kids are less than thrilled—particularly, Kathy.

videos.title: The Promising Young Man
videos.overview: The boss's son goes to work in Jim's office.

videos.title: Margaret Hires a Gardener
videos.overview: A Spanish immigrant, Frank, fixes the Andersons lawn and then    charges a high price.

videos.title: Swiss Family Anderson
videos.overview: The Anderson family becomes shipwrecked on a deserted island.

videos.title: Brief Holiday
videos.overview: Margaret takes a small, much-needed break from her daily duties.

videos.title: The Lawn Party
videos.overview: Bud tells the family they are to set up for a lawn party that    is tomorrow.

videos.title: Short Wave
videos.overview: While listening to Bud’s short wave radio, the family overhears a distress call from a boat.

videos.title: Carnival
videos.overview: Bud squanders Jim's money at a carnival.

videos.title: Betty and the Jet Pilot
videos.overview: Betty's new boyfriend, a jet pilot, is transferred to Alaska.

videos.title: Trip to Hillsborough
videos.overview: Looking for adventure, Bud travels to a neighboring town.

videos.title: An Evening to Remember
videos.overview: The Anderson home is disrupted by a visit from actor Cornel Wilde.

videos.title: Bud Buys a Car
videos.overview: Bud buys a car for $10.

videos.title: Safety First
videos.overview: When Bud receives a traffic ticket, he is forced to become a crossing guard.

videos.title: Bud, the Hero
videos.overview: Bud…a hero? A chain reaction of events, starting with a girl who wants to use Bud to make her boyfriend jealous, leads to Bud becoming a hero of the town.

videos.title: Betty, the Track Star
videos.overview: Betty has to choose between a flower queen contest and a track race, occurring on the same afternoon.

videos.title: The Spelling Bee
videos.overview: Kathy is apprehensive about the prospect of competing at the county spelling bee.

videos.title: Bud, the Philanthropist
videos.overview: Bud obsesses over getting credit for a generous donation he made.

videos.title: Baby in the House
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret take care of a baby Betty is supposed to babysit, so she can go out.

videos.title: Class Prophecy
videos.overview: Henry Pruett, a traveling salesman, knocks on the Anderson’s door. It turns out she, Jim and Henry all attended college together.

videos.title: The Art of Romance
videos.overview: Bud gets advice from Jim on how to win over Judy, while Judy asks gets advice from Betty.

videos.title: Margaret Disowns Her Family
videos.overview: Margaret tries to help a young woman overcome her fear of    having a baby.

videos.title: Grandpa Retires
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret are called in to help Margaret's dad, who's about to hand over his printing office and retire.

videos.title: Shoot for the Moon
videos.overview: Sageman helps the Andersons regain their self-confidence.

videos.title: Follow the Leader
videos.overview: Bud must decide if he should stand up for a teacher or join    the class in a revolt.

videos.title: The Awkward Hero
videos.overview: Betty tutors a football player who will escort her to a dance    as payment.

videos.title: The Good Neighbor
videos.overview: Margaret receives a new house which she plans to rent out.

videos.title: Bud, the Executive
videos.overview: Bud becomes the chairman for the planning of his high school    picnic.

videos.title: Sentenced to Happiness
videos.overview: The Anderson's gardener, Frank, is forced to get a real job    and then winds up in court.

videos.title: Mother Goes to School
videos.overview: Margaret enrolls in an English class in college and is put in    Betty's class.

videos.title: The Indispensable Man
videos.overview: Bud is not able to play in the football game because he    wouldn't go to bed early.

videos.title: Kathy's Big Chance
videos.overview: Kathy competes in an essay contest judged by Greer Garson.

videos.title: Margaret Learns to Drive
videos.overview: Jim tries to teach Margaret how to drive a car.

videos.title: The Way of a Dictator
videos.overview: Bud is given the pleasure of raising Kathy when he says they    are doing it all wrong.

videos.title: Mr. Beal Meets His Match
videos.overview: Betty is going through a phase where she thinks selfishness is the sole motivator in people's lives.

videos.title: Kathy Makes a Wish
videos.overview: When Kathy finds a horseshoe and she wishes for a horse, and    gets one.

videos.title: Man With a Plan
videos.overview: A girl thinks Bud is going into the Army and throws a going    away party.

videos.title: Big Sister
videos.overview: At summer camp Kathy rebels after her counselor, Betty, keeps   pushing her to do better.

videos.title: Calypso Kid
videos.overview: Bud practices the bongo drums to impress his new girlfriend.

videos.title: Father's Biography
videos.overview: Jim can either attend a business meeting or see Kathy read    his biography.

videos.title: The Rivals
videos.overview: Betty has two dates for the same night and doesn't plan to   break either one.

videos.title: Bud, the Mind Reader
videos.overview: Bud practices mind reading, and Betty tries to make the    debating team.

videos.title: Margaret's Other Family
videos.overview: The family gets mad when Margaret keeps helping a furniture    maker and his wife.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Bud is in trouble when he is accused of causing damage to a    neighbor's property.

videos.title: Revenge is Sweet
videos.overview: 26Feb58   Betty teases Bud saying he is sloppy when some very influential   people come over.

videos.title: Country Cousin
videos.overview: The Anderson's cousin, Milly, arrives for a visit and to    look at the college.

videos.title: Poor Old Dad
videos.overview: Bud believes that his father is henpecked when he willingly    does everything Margaret wants him to.

videos.title: Betty's Crusade
videos.overview: Betty tries to help an old man fix up his restaurant so he    isn't evicted by Jim's company.

videos.title: Young Love
videos.overview: Bud falls in love with an older woman at the grocery store    who is married.

videos.title: Tell It to Mom
videos.overview: Chaos strikes when Betty hides a pair of skates for a friend    of hers.

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: A very talented dog shows up and takes residence in the    Anderson's house.

videos.title: A Medal For Margaret
videos.overview: When Jim plans to build a case for trophies, and Margaret    sets out to win a medal.

videos.title: The Weaker Sex
videos.overview: Betty tries to use her feminine wiles on a young man to get    him to take her out.

videos.title: Jim, the Answer Man
videos.overview: Jim is bombarded with questions when he is getting ready for    a business trip.

videos.title: Bud Quits School
videos.overview: When Bud meets a successful business man who quit school and   Bud plans to do the same.

videos.title: A Matter of Pride
videos.overview: Bud is chosen as the most popular boy in his class at school.

videos.title: Betty Finds a Cause
videos.overview: Betty tries to make a man remove a hedge that blocks the    view on a road.

videos.title: Vine Covered Cottage
videos.overview: Betty and Ralph plan to get married, but find it is not as    happy as they thought.

videos.title: Be Kind to Bud Week
videos.overview: Bud thinks Betty has an ulterior motive when she is kind to him.

videos.title: Kathy's Romance
videos.overview: Kathy's new boyfriend is more interested in Jim than of Kathy.

videos.title: Voice From the Past
videos.overview: Bud prepares for the arrival of the homecoming queen.

videos.title: Frank's Family Tress
videos.overview: Frank tries to console Kathy by telling her that his family    are entertainers.

videos.title: Always Plan Ahead
videos.overview: Jim tries to teach the children a lesson when they are    constantly not planning ahead.

videos.title: Second Wedding
videos.overview: Betty talks Jim and Margaret into getting married again for    their anniversary.

videos.title: Bud, the Caretaker
videos.overview: Bud finds a dent on the back of the car he is watching for a    friend.

videos.title: Betty, the Pioneer Woman
videos.overview: Betty plays the founder of Springfield's wife in a play of    what really happened.

videos.title: Fair Exchange
videos.overview: An Indian exchange student arrives for the weekend from    Betty's college.

videos.title: Margaret Wins a Car
videos.overview: In a raffle, Margaret wins a car and uses it to help the    orphans home.

videos.title: The Great Experiment
videos.overview: Jim attempts to get the family to broaden their horizons and    disaster strikes.

videos.title: The Christmas Story
videos.overview: The family recalls as they are putting up the   Christmas tree, how Jim wanted them to cut their own tree, and in the process got stranded in a cabin.

videos.title: The Basketball Coach
videos.overview: Jim becomes the coach of Bud's basketball team.

videos.title: Kathy, Girl Executive
videos.overview: Kathy is elected by the family to control Bud's lawn moving    company.

videos.title: The Good Samaritan
videos.overview: 5Jan59   Bud must do a good deed for an English report and ends up    resenting the whole world.

videos.title: The Ideal Father
videos.overview: Uncle Charlie believes the children are spoiled when they    forget Jim's birthday.

videos.title: Big Shot Bud
videos.overview: Bud gets into hot water when he tries to buy Margaret a   bottle of expensive perfume.

videos.title: Hard Luck Leo
videos.overview: Leo visits and takes advantage of the whole family until    something surprising happens.

videos.title: Bud, the Campus Romeo
videos.overview: When Bus refuses dates, the girl launch an anti-Bud campaign.

videos.title: Crisis Over a Kiss
videos.overview: Bud tries to save Betty from her boyfriend but Betty    resents the help.

videos.title: Kathy Grows Up
videos.overview: Kathy says she wants to be treated as if she was an adult.

videos.title: A Man of Merit
videos.overview: Jim learns that he is to be appointed as an outstanding    person in the community.

videos.title: Betty Makes a Choice
videos.overview: Betty is faced with a hard decision that will affect her    future.

videos.title: It's a Small World
videos.overview: Margaret must decide to attend a luncheon or go with Jim on    an important trip.

videos.title: Two Loves Has Bud
videos.overview: Bud has a hard time when he must decide between two girls to    take to the prom.

videos.title: An Extraordinary Woman
videos.overview: The Anderson's are visited by an author on African Culture.

videos.title: Formula for Happiness
videos.overview: Strange things begin to happen when Jim's dreams start to come    true.

videos.title: Bud and the Debutante
videos.overview: Bud tries to impress a wealthy girl by taking her to an    expensive restaurant.

videos.title: The Promised Playhouse
videos.overview: A flashback show about building a playhouse for Kathy.

videos.title: The Meanest Professor
videos.overview: Bud regrets writing a bad article about a professor after the    professor finds the article.

videos.title: Live My Own Life
videos.overview: This is a recut version of episode 5 with the same name where Bud goes out on his own and tries to make   good.

videos.title: Bud Has A Problem
videos.overview: Bud blames his professor when it appears he will not pass    Physics.

videos.title: The Great Anderson Mystery
videos.overview: The Andersons act out a detective story when the television    breaks down.

videos.title: Margaret Goes Dancing Flashback
videos.overview: Margaret wants Jim to take her dancing. She tries to trick him into dance lessons.

videos.title: The Gold Turnip
videos.overview: 1Jun59   Bud feels that there is no use for tradition so he starts to   break all traditions.

videos.title: A Day in the Country
videos.overview: While on the way to visit Margaret's parents, the car breaks down leaving the family stranded on a   deserted road.

videos.title: Bud Branches Out
videos.overview: Bud falls in love with his college French professor.

videos.title: The Gardener's Big Day
videos.overview: Frank is chosen to represent the town at the opening of a park, but when the town council meets Frank,   they want another person to represent their city- someone who looks more like an average American.

videos.title: The Imposter
videos.overview: Betty becomes involved with a young lawyer pretending to be the owner of a radio store.

videos.title: Bud Plays It Safe
videos.overview: Bud decides to date the coach's daughter in order to make sure he gets on the football team.

videos.title: Bicycle Trip for Two
videos.overview: Jim's plans for a quiet bicycle trip end up with Jim and Margaret arguing

videos.title: First Disillusionment
videos.overview: Bud tells Kathy about the job he didn't get when another boy faked his credentials.

videos.title: Margaret's Old Flame
videos.overview: Jim and Margaret tease one another about people they dated as their college reunion nears.

videos.title: Kathy Becomes a Girl
videos.overview: The family tries to change Kathy from a tomboy into a beautiful girl.

videos.title: Bud, the Willing Worker
videos.overview: Bud wants a part-time job at a service station in order to get enough money to buy a boat.

videos.title: Turn the Other Cheek
videos.overview: Both Jim and Kathy are doublecrossed by their friends.

videos.title: Good Joke on Mom
videos.overview: Margaret tricks the family into believing that she has been elected chairwoman of the children's clinic   building program.

videos.title: Betty's Double
videos.overview: Betty wins a trip to Hollywood because she looks like a famous movie star.

videos.title: Father, the Naturalist
videos.overview: This is a recut version of episode 30. It is not part of the current syndication package and is considered   ""lost"".

videos.title: Bud Hides Behind a Skirt
videos.overview: Betty is campaigning for safe driving, while Bud is accused of reckless driving.

videos.title: Togetherness
videos.overview: A reporter visits the family in order to do an article on family togetherness.

videos.title: Second Best
videos.overview: Betty competes in the college fencing tournament.

videos.title: Kathy's Big Deception
videos.overview: Kathy, desperate for a date at the community picnic, makes up a story about a boyfriend.

videos.title: Cupid Knows Best
videos.overview: Kathy, desperate for a date at the community picnic, makes up a story about a boyfriend.

videos.title: The Big Test
videos.overview: Betty arranges a match between Frank and a worker in a flower shop.

videos.title: Jim's Big Surprise
videos.overview: Jim is surprised by his family's lack of interest when he is named Father of the Year.

videos.title: Time to Retire
videos.overview: When Bud reaffirms and old man's belief in life, he decides to open his own insurance company and hire   Bud as his assistant.

videos.title: Bud, the Speculator
videos.overview: Bud invests money in a phony stock scheme and winds up losing fifty dollars

videos.title: The $500 Letter
videos.overview: The Andersons get a check from an admirer and must find out which member of the family the check was   meant for.

videos.title: Adopted Daughter
videos.overview: While Kathy is trying to repair her birth certificate frame, she recalls the time she thought she was adopted.

videos.title: Family Contest
videos.overview: Kathy destroys a picture of a family competing against hers in a photo contest

videos.title: Love and Learn
videos.overview: Bud falls in love with his English Tutor

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: Betty dates a boy everyone regards as a loser

videos.title: Betty's Career Problem

videos.title: Betty's Graduation
videos.overview: When Kathy refuses to graduate from high school, the family tells her about Betty's reluctance to graduate   from High School, too. This is a recut version of episode 63. It is not part of the syndication package and   is considered ""lost"".

videos.title: Twenty-Four Hours in Tyrantland
videos.overview: In 1959 the producers were approached to do a U.S. Savings Bond benefit for the American Federation of Labor and the Treasury Department. Though never aired on television, it was distributed to schools, churches, and civic groups. Extremely rare copies can still be found.
